description: Authored cut-throughs: narrow alleys between two existing junctions, placed where the race generator's draw runs out of priced legs ahead (pnpm alder:critique --try=nodeA,nodeB scores a candidate). Each is 8 m wide, one lane each way, and displaces the generated plots it crosses. Game coordinates in metres; endpoints are existing junction vertices.

roads.name: Freight Cut
roads.why: Every generated race began at a dead spot: from the grid, the run up 1st Ave S had no alternative within 40% at all (Holgate to Harbor Access is 680 m without a cross street), so 300 of 300 first legs were no-choice. Measured 2026-09-11: draws made where nothing priced or even was ahead fell from 382 of 1167 to 59 of 1183 over 300 seeds, the priced-or-even share of the draw rose from 48% to 62%, and 196 of 300 first legs became priced or even. It displaces two warehouse plots.
